summary: Tested the new public vendor storefront feature (Phase 1 enhancement). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_storefront.py — 9/9 passed covering GET /api/vendors/{id} happy path + 3 negative cases (malformed -> 400 'Invalid id format', non-existent -> 404, non-approved vendor -> 404), pending-product-leak filter (flipped test-vendor-ui-tomato to pending via admin PATCH, verified it disappears from products[], then restored to approved), plus smoke on /api/products, /api/vendors, /api/products/{slug} (exposes vendor_id/vendor_name), /api/categories. No _id leakage. Frontend: /vendors/6a68cd452d6830a591905de5 renders hero (Verified vendor badge, business name, description, address+pincode, '1 product'), 'Available now' grid with ProductCard; add-to-cart on storefront card works (switches to qty stepper, cart badge updates); 404/malformed ids show vendor-storefront-missing fallback; ProductCard vendor pill (vendor-badge-test-vendor-ui-tomato) navigates to /vendors/<id> without triggering the parent product link; PDP pdp-vendor-link present and navigates to storefront; admin products (fresh-tomato/onion/banana) correctly show no pill on card or PDP. Regression smoke: home + /products load, admin login + /admin dashboard loads (Revenue/Orders/Vendors widgets), fresh customer registration + COD checkout from storefront-added item landed on /orders/6a68d64b4dd684848e835af6 with correct totals (65 + 30 delivery = 95).

issues: Malformed vendor id (backend 400) renders generic 'Unable to load vendor.' instead of 'Vendor not found.' — consider treating 400 like 404 for a cleaner message.
Vendor pill on ProductCard truncates long business names ('by TEST UI Kirana 178525…'); acceptable by design but a title/tooltip attribute would help.

critical_code_review_comments: VendorStorefront.jsx useEffect does not reset `error` to null when `id` changes; a stale error state would persist on client-side navigation between two /vendors/:id routes (component is not remounted). Add setError(null) at the start of the effect.
Optional: map HTTP 400 (invalid id format) to the same 'Vendor not found' fallback copy in VendorStorefront.jsx.
seed_data_creation: Registered throwaway customer test_cust_1785255490@example.com / Test@123 and placed one COD order (6a68d64b4dd684848e835af6) for checkout regression. Vendor product test-vendor-ui-tomato was temporarily set to pending and restored to approved (verified approved at end of run).
